title: Pending | 72 Hours Not Elapsed | APPR
description:
Flight occurred less than 72 hours ago. DDS hasn't processed the data yet because the standard processing window is 72 hours after the flight. Case is created in Pending state. System will auto-assess when DDS data becomes available after the 72-hour window. Differs from TC_018 (Welcome Back) � here the system creates a pending case without customer interaction, whereas Welcome Back involves the customer filing early and being notified later.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Itinerary: Flight operated yesterday (within 72hr window). Scheduled arrival 14:00, Actual arrival 18:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: Not yet available in DDS (within 72hr processing window). Filing time: 24 hours after flight (within 72hr window). DDS status: Data processing not yet complete.
